criteria.description: Defines one core message (roof) in customer-benefit terms, not a tagline/slogan or multiple competing 'main' messages.
Provides 2-4 benefit-led pillars that support the core message, rather than feature names as pillars.
Backs each pillar with proof/evidence (the construction features — Gantt, RFIs, daily logs, etc. — appear here as proof, not as the message).
Translates the messaging for different audiences (e.g. project manager, foreman/field, owner/exec) rather than one-size-fits-all.
Produces a reusable architecture the whole company can pull from, not just a single new tagline.
